m0-context.title: Load baseline context and verify handoff completeness
m0-context.imperative: Read handoff, crew context, glossary; verify task/intent/scope/exclusions/evidence/test-mode/stop-conditions all present. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: Handoff complete: task=season aggregator + baseline script, intent=correct reproducible 2025 season score, scope=fantasy_scoring/season.py + scripts/run_walkforward_baseline.py + test file + reports dir, exclusions=gold cycle/training, test-mode=TDD required, stop-conditions=schema mismatch / DB helper missing / scope expansion / implausible result
postconditions.satisfied_by: Handoff verified complete: task=season aggregator + baseline script, intent=correct reproducible 2025 season score from promoted-gold per-race predictions, scope=new season.py + run_walkforward_baseline.py + test file + reports/walkforward/ dir, exclusions=gold cycle/training/prediction code, test-mode=TDD required, stop-conditions=schema mismatch/DB helper missing/scope expansion/implausible result. DB helper get_session_classification confirmed present at src/data/database/_metadata.py:390. Per-race prediction schema confirmed: predictions list with rank/driver_id/driver_name/team/score fields.

m1-red-tests.title: Write failing TDD tests for season aggregator
m1-red-tests.imperative: Write tests/unit/fantasy_scoring/test_season_aggregation.py covering: known synthetic season total, top-10 extraction, DNF path (predicted driver absent from actuals), provenance carry-through. Tests must fail (import error or assertion error) before implementation. Run to confirm red.

preconditions.statement: context loaded, handoff complete, season.py does not yet exist
preconditions.satisfied_by: context loaded; handoff complete (m0 attested); season.py does not exist (confirmed via glob search)

postconditions.statement: test file exists and fails with ImportError or AttributeError (season.py absent)

constraints: Tests use synthetic fixtures only; do NOT load 27MB sampled_runtime files

m2-green-season.title: Implement src/fantasy_scoring/season.py and make tests green
m2-green-season.imperative: Write the season aggregator: extract_top10_picks(predictions_json) -> List[(driver_id, rank)]; RaceResult dataclass (round, gp_name, top10_picks, actual_results, provenance); SeasonAggregator.aggregate(races) -> SeasonResult with per-race breakdown and season total. Use ScoringCalculator.fantasy_score_from_predictions; source-agnostic (no hardcoded paths). Validate inputs with descriptive messages. Run tests green.

preconditions.satisfied_by: m1-red-tests complete; test file exists and is failing with ImportError

constraints: Do NOT re-implement scoring semantics; delegate to ScoringCalculator.fantasy_score_from_predictions
DB helper load_actuals_from_db is a helper function (not cached)
Logging via logging.getLogger(__name__); print() stays in scripts

m3-green-baseline-script.title: Implement scripts/run_walkforward_baseline.py
m3-green-baseline-script.imperative: Write the baseline script: discover round01..round24 per_race_predictions JSONs, extract top10 from each, load actual R results from 2025 DB, aggregate via SeasonAggregator, print season total + per-race table, write reports/walkforward/walkforward_2025_baseline.json. Label as no-in-season-retrain baseline.

postconditions.statement: script runs without error and writes the JSON report

constraints: DB-only for actuals; 2025 DB path = data/f1_data_2025.db
Print season total and per-race table to stdout

m4-reports-dir.title: Verify reports/walkforward/ directory and artifacts exist
m4-reports-dir.imperative: Confirm walkforward_2025_baseline.json and .md are written by the script. Check the JSON is valid and plausible (not all-DNF).

postconditions.statement: baseline JSON exists and contains season_total field

check.command: py -c "import json,pathlib; d=json.loads(pathlib.Path('reports/walkforward/walkforward_2025_baseline.json').read_text()); assert 'season_total' in d, 'missing season_total'; assert d['season_total'] < 5000, f'implausible total {d[\"season_total\"]}'; print('OK season_total=', d['season_total'])"

payload.cmd: py -c "import json,pathlib; d=json.loads(pathlib.Path('reports/walkforward/walkforward_2025_baseline.json').read_text()); assert 'season_total' in d, 'missing season_total'; assert d['season_total'] < 5000, f'implausible total {d[\"season_total\"]}'; print('OK season_total=', d['season_total'])"

m5-simplification-check.title: Run simplification_limits on all touched src/ and tests/ paths
m5-simplification-check.imperative: Run py -m src.utils.simplification_limits --paths src/fantasy_scoring/season.py tests/unit/fantasy_scoring/test_season_aggregation.py. Must pass with no violations.

m6-evidence.title: Capture all required evidence and return IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m6-evidence.imperative: Run all three verification commands from the handoff. Capture full output. Confirm: tests green, baseline printed with season total + per-race table, simplification check passes. Return IMPLEMENTER_RESULT.
